title: Layout without Body part
description: Best-practice rule — flags layouts that have no Body part. Without a Body, records do not render in Form/List view; usually a stray or mis-built layout.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A layout with no Body cannot show record data in the usual views.
rule.remediation: Add a Body part, or remove the layout if it is not a deliberate dialog shell.
